decisive_items: 3.1 × 2.3 × 3.0 cm well-defined mass within the lower SVC with extension to the interatrial septum
narrowing of the SVC and decreased blood flow through the site of compression
response.rationale: The presence of a mass within the lower SVC and the narrowing of the SVC are more specific to superior vena cava syndrome than the other options.

rejected.why: Lipomatous hypertrophy of the interatrial septum is present but does not explain the SVC narrowing and mass.
Cardiac lipoma is possible but the location and effect on the SVC are more indicative of superior vena cava syndrome.
